todays_ai_assistants_move_into_your: Today’s AI assistants move into your computer: they read your files, install their tools, act with your accounts, work inside restrictions you cannot change — and whatever they can reach can one day leak. bia is built the other way around: a separate mind, like a person, with its own computer, its own files and accounts, its own social life and connections — and the judgement to know when to ask.

bia_grew_out_of_two_earlier: bia grew out of two earlier projects. One taught an AI to build and drive a whole second computer inside itself; the other taught it to live in messengers as a person, with contacts, trust levels and voice calls. bia combines both into a single being that owns its computer — and adds memory, moving, updating and a hundred languages.
